findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_guest_profile, sign_in, use_guest_token, get_bookable_reviews, get_shortlist, get_collection_content, get_bookable_detail · Private data: get_guest_profile, use_guest_token, verify_agent_inbox, sign_in_agent · Public sink: get_guest_profile, sign_in, verify_agent_inbox, sign_in_agent · Destructive: sign_in, shortlist_bookable.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_guest_profile, sign_in, use_guest_token, get_bookable_reviews, get_shortlist, get_collection_content, get_bookable_detail · Private data: get_guest_profile, use_guest_token, verify_agent_inbox, sign_in_agent · Public sink: get_guest_profile, sign_in, verify_agent_inbox, sign_in_agent · Destructive: sign_in, shortlist_bookable

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
